faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Can foreigners rent apartments in Japan?
faq.a1: Yes. Every apartment on this site accepts foreign residents. You need a residence card (or a visa if applying from overseas) and proof of income or school enrollment.
faq.q2: I don't have a Japanese guarantor. What can I do?
faq.a2: Most apartments use a guarantor company instead of a personal guarantor. Filter by “No guarantor needed” to see them.
faq.a3: Usually the first month's rent, deposit, key money, agency fee, guarantor company fee, fire insurance and key exchange. Each listing shows them line by line with the total.
faq.q4: Can I apply before I arrive in Japan?
faq.a4: Yes, for apartments marked “Apply from overseas”. Viewings can be done by video call.
faq.q5: How long does it take to move in?
faq.a5: Usually 2–4 weeks from application to receiving the keys, depending on screening.

partner.photosEyebrow: Homes we found for referred clients
partner.benefitsText: We built the program around one idea: every introduction deserves a fair and reliable reward. Here is what that looks like.

fee.title: A fee for every signed contract
fee.text: Earn a referral fee for each client who signs a lease with us. No sign-up cost and no minimum – you introduce, we handle it, you get paid.

scale.title: Better rates as you grow
scale.text: The more contracts come from your referrals, the better your terms. Regular partners move up automatically, with priority support.

care.title: Support after the keys
care.text: We stay with your client after signing: utilities, internet, furniture rental and local rules such as garbage sorting – so their first weeks go smoothly.

language.title: Three languages, one contact
language.text: English, Burmese and Japanese from the first message to the contract, with one person who follows each client you send.

upfront.title: Every cost shown upfront
upfront.text: Your clients see the full move-in cost before they apply – no surprises that come back to you later.

partner.scaleText: Partners with regular contracts are upgraded automatically: a higher rate, a senior advisor and joint marketing as the partnership grows.
partner.benefitsNote: Referral fees are agreed with each partner.
partner.stepsText: Becoming a partner is simple. We keep it light on your side – your only job is the introduction.

s1.title: Apply as a partner
s1.text: Fill in the form below – tell us about your organization, your network and how many referrals you expect. We reply within 2 business days with a plan.

s2.title: Introduce clients
s2.text: When someone needs a home, send us a quick message or ask them to mention your partner code when they contact us. That’s it – no forms or case management on your side.

s3.title: Receive your fee
s3.text: Your fee is paid once the lease is signed. Regular partners move to a higher rate automatically – no renegotiation needed.
